title: A Crown in the Ashes
text: When the old foundry on the river finally burns out, the ashes give up a crown of iron, nailed together, a saint's name stamped inside it. Every smith in the city wants it melted, and every House wants it worn. The foundry-master will sell it for iron, not gold.

options.label: Send a sealed bid of iron, hoping the crown comes to your House.

outcomes.text: Your iron is carted to the ruin, where the foundry-master weighs it against a skull on the other pan.

options.label: Let someone else wear it; a saint's crown is a heavy thing.

outcomes.text: You keep your iron and watch to see whose head the crown ends up on.

together.text: Nobody bids. The foundry-master sets the crown on his own head and walks into the river. He is not seen again.

prize.text: The crown is yours. Whoever wears it hears the iron saint's last sermon every night, word for word, and rises a little straighter in the morning.
